name: Mensculine
product_facts: Lead product: Mensculine Care Cream (topical; Malaysia domestic counterpart is Menss Care Cream on https://menss.co/)
color_rules: 60:30:10 (black foundation, light/white structure, vivid blue accent)
White on Vivid Blue is only 3.5:1; use Obsidian text on blue
Vivid Blue only for the icon and one highlight on black

fonts.display: Poppins SemiBold / Bold; Montserrat for subtitles and labels

files: light and dark lockups, secondary compact, text lockup
rules: Use light or dark lockup to match background; never mix
Never recolour the icon; never retype the wordmark
Do not use the archived Xprimal identity
Clear space = wordmark cap height; min 120 px / 30 mm wide

graphic_device: Chevron Drive (pattern.svg): dark bands and packaging sides, copy on solid panels, do not rotate
avoid: Market-specific claims that are not cleared
doctor_allowed_in_ads: not addressed in guideline; ask brand owner
source: SuamiSihat Design System repo (static/products/<slug>/metadata.json, docs/claims-review/README.md and audit-2026-10-13.md), plus brand guideline v1.0 PDFs (16 Oct 2026)
staff_claims_review: Ingredient and effect statements must follow each export market's cosmetic rules
